children: Desai brings over three decades of HR experience across manufacturing, industrial relations and employee development to Nandan Petrochem
Nandan Petrochem Limited has appointed Ashish Desai as Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), adding more than 30 years of human resources experience to its leadership team.

Desai joins Nandan Petrochem from Everest Industries, where he served as General Manager and Head of Corporate Industrial Relations. His experience spans manufacturing HR, industrial relations, employee relations, people development and business HR.

Before Everest Industries, Desai was General Manager and Head HR at Mahindra CIE Automotive, leading HR and industrial relations for its Chakan operations. He also spent more than five years with Larsen & Toubro as AGM and Head HR, Personnel, for its Electrical & Automation business.

Earlier, Desai served as Group Head, Business HR at Tata Power’s Transmission & Distribution division and spent around 17 years with Mahindra & Mahindra’s Farm Division, where he worked across employee relations and development.
At Nandan Petrochem, Desai will lead the HR function, with a focus on people and organisational priorities, culture, employee relations and workforce development.
